name: wind-frame
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: transparent portrait decorative adornment PNG, wind-frame. Input image is the edit target. Repaint this adornment with dramatically less detail. Keep its theme, palette, portrait aspect ratio, placement and general silhouette. Keep the full perimeter frame with large empty transparent center. Use only a few WIDE soft wet watercolor brush strokes and large simple color masses, gently blended pigment with translucent feathered outer edges. Reduce internal detail by about 80 percent. Leaves become simple broad brush-dab silhouettes without veins; waves become two or three broad curved washes with soft cream crests, no bubbles or intricate foam; wind becomes broad airy ribbons with few curls; fire becomes broad warm flowing strokes; earth becomes a few broad ochre and brown shapes with minimal faceting. No fine lines, tiny curls, flecks, particles, harsh outlines, dense grain, intricate texture, realistic rendering, lettering or watermark. Preserve generous negative space and true alpha transparency in center and outside edges. The final should feel loose, quiet, soft, and hand-painted rather than ornate.
